signature.basis: First signature, Session 22 Stage 7, at PINNED_AS_OF 2026-09-09, extraction v29. Ladder amounts, subtotals and totals hand-verified against the filings; no wrong number found. Every displayed figure checked against the sentence shown beside it, not merely present somewhere in the corpus (Rule 46) — belonging clean, 0 composites. Facility maturities verified against their own sentences; where the instrument's own cited sentence does not state the date, it is taken from the facility's own maturity sentence and labelled when that sits outside the anchor. CACHE_BUST x3 at v29 after row identity moved off the label: 6 rows in every run, 5 classed in every run, row set / amounts / classes identical across all three. The facility is named "revolving credit facility" in one run and "Credit Facility" in two — the filing uses both — and identity now keys on the facts the filing states about the instrument, so the rename is reported as a rename rather than as a row removed and a row added.

results.evidence: No material capex program or new facility construction is disclosed. The company reports purchases of property, equipment and capitalized software of $57 million for the six months ended June 30, 2026, which represents routine maintenance capex, not a named major project.

As of June 30, 2026, no amounts were outstanding under the Credit Agreement. The company had available borrowing capacity of $1.25 billion under the $1.25 billion revolving credit facility, meaning the revolver is not drawn and is not near capacity.

In April 2025, the board authorized the purchase of up to $1 billion of common stock through December 31, 2026. As of July 17, 2026, $500 million remained available under this program, indicating $500 million has been repurchased year-to-date.

results.evidence: No asset sale or divestiture is disclosed in the current period. The company exited the MAPD product line for 2027 (announced in February 2026), but this is a product exit, not an asset sale. No business unit or asset sale is reported.

No international expansion or foreign revenue growth is disclosed. Molina Healthcare operates exclusively in the United States under Medicaid, Medicare, and Marketplace programs. No geographic segment reporting shows foreign revenue.
New subsidiary formation is typically not disclosed in public filings unless tied to a reported acquisition. No new subsidiary formation is disclosed in the current filings.

No IPO or secondary equity offering is disclosed. Molina Healthcare is an established public company trading on the NYSE under ticker MOH. No equity offering is announced or completed in the current period.

All outstanding debt is fixed-rate senior notes. The 4.375% Notes due 2028, 3.875% Notes due 2030, 6.500% Notes due 2031, 3.875% Notes due 2032, and 6.250% Notes due 2033 are all fixed-rate instruments. No floating-rate debt is outstanding.

No material commodity or input-cost exposure is disclosed in the risk factors or MD&A. As a managed healthcare company, Molina's primary cost drivers are medical care costs and pharmacy costs, which are not commodity-based exposures in the traditional sense.

No material foreign-currency exposure is disclosed. Molina Healthcare operates exclusively in the United States and has no significant international operations or foreign-currency-denominated assets or liabilities.
